description: This file contains a helper class for integrating with OpenAI's API, providing methods to generate prompts for code analysis, improvement, and simulation, as well as executing chat completions and extracting code blocks from text.

classes.name: OpenAIHelper
classes.description: A helper class for interacting with OpenAI API, generating prompts for code review, improvement, simulation, and handling chat completions.

methods.name: generate_initial_scoring_query
methods.description: Creates a prompt to evaluate the quality and optimizeability of a specific function based on its code and context.

methods.name: generate_improvement_query
methods.description: Creates a prompt to suggest a safe code improvement for a function, given its implementation and context.

methods.name: generate_simulation_query
methods.description: Creates a prompt to simulate and verify the correctness of a function with given input and output examples.

methods.name: generate_after_insert_style_query
methods.description: Creates a prompt to verify style and consistency after programmatic code modifications.

methods.name: call_chatgpt
methods.description: Executes a chat completion request to OpenAI's GPT-4 model with the provided query.

methods.name: extract_first_code_block
methods.description: Extracts the first code block from a text, removing language specifier if present.
